item.title: World of Warcraft: Midnight global launch times — here's when the game will be released in early access and for the general public
item.description: Blizzard Entertainment has released the final, definitive public release and early access dates for World of Warcraft's upcoming Midnight expansion, and we have curated them so you won't miss out on the launch.

item.title: Surface Pro update fixes key cellular bugs — just as Microsoft leans into 5G
item.description: Microsoft’s latest Surface Pro firmware update fixes VPN and cellular issues, arriving as the company deepens its 5G push through a new Ericsson partnership.

item.title: The Windows Control Panel is one step closer to death as account rename option makes its way to Windows 11's Settings app
item.description: Microsoft is adding the ability to rename your user account to the Windows 11 Settings app, ported over from the legacy Control Panel.

item.title: Report: Former Xbox President Sarah Bond's direction "offended" employees — "This is an Xbox" marketing campaign deemed failure
item.description: With Phil Spencer's departure, Xbox employees are supposedly relieved that the President of Xbox has left as well.

item.title: Call of Duty: Warzone just got MORE easter eggs with exclusive rewards — here's how to get the new parachute and weapon blueprint
item.description: Hunting for the new Shattered Echo weapon blueprint in Call of Duty: Warzone? Here's what you have to do.

item.title: Tencent just killed a fledgling AAA open-world game studio before it could even release anything — "I am genuinely heartbroken"
item.description: Game publisher Tencent has shut down TiMi Montreal, a fledgling studio that hadn't even released its first game — a AAA open-world title — yet.

item.title: WWE 2K26 latest trailer gives more details on controversial The Island mode — and it's already looking WAY better than it was in WWE 2K25
item.description: WWE and 2K have disclosed the full details on what players can expect to experience in WWE 2K26's version of WWE 2K25's The Island mode, from a new non-linear story to expanded gameplay features.

item.title: Xbox co-founder believes “Xbox is being sunsetted” — as Microsoft pivots to AI
item.description: Xbox co-founder Seamus Blackley has raised concerns that Microsoft’s increasing focus on AI could sideline the Xbox brand. In a recent interview, he argues that Xbox is being “sunsetted” as the company pivots toward generative AI, though his comments remain speculative.

item.title: Bethesda's Todd Howard says "you can't ignore" AI tools, but notes "we're not using it to generate anything" for Xbox's The Elder Scrolls 6 — "I'll just say we're looking at that stuff"
item.description: Bethesda game director Todd Howard says it's not using AI to "generate anything," but acknowledges its potential as a tool and says "you can't ignore" it.

item.title: Call of Duty sharply denies rumor that Xbox is making a standalone Zombies game — "The rumor factory working overtime. This ain't it."
item.description: A well-known Call of Duty leaker has suggested Xbox is considering a standalone Zombies game, but the series' developers have denied the rumor.
